subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘HAPPY’ is written as ‘JDPSA’ and ‘DANCE’ is written as ‘FDNFG’. How will ‘CLASS’ be written in that language?
solution:
The alphabets and their positions are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2074f2af1444ff647bcff61bf4a768c4f4d9fb9ab69389563894deb3580edad.png] 

The logic here is:

For the word ‘HAPPY’ is written as ‘JDPSA’ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e2cbfd7b92a17c072982d470fa1dab023f03a24e4471de6c69e8c0372f5cc90.png] 

And for the word ‘DANCE’ is written as ‘FDNFG’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1401a4644dc67a8d712d8bcaf333bd2a02eb6a06e246a3787d511d1d9e43cc6.png] 

Similarly, for the word CLASS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ad86f6b5564ce3932fa0cdeb9b40a7aab436c74cc079be01400c590f0629052.png] 

Thus, the next letter cluster is EOAVU.

Hence, the correct answer is '__option 4__'.
